Corrections: the effect exhausts OTHER non-Attacks only — Attacks in hand (e.g. Fiend Fire) are NOT exhausted and SW itself does not count toward its own exhaust-block total (2 Defends in hand → exhaust count 2, Block 10 at base values). Charon's Ashes procs once per card the effect exhausts, not on SW itself. Trap cards (FranticEscape-class) are defused by this exhaust — they are discarded-to-exhaust without their on-play downside firing. An event enchant granting +2 Block per exhausted card stacked with a smith upgrade that added +2 more (7→9 per card on an enchanted copy; the table's +7 upgrade value did not appear on that path).
